name: restoreproof
description: Back up a Supabase, Neon or Postgres database and prove the backup restores: pg_dump, then a restore into a throwaway PostgreSQL of the same version, then every table, column, constraint, index, view, function, trigger, RLS policy and row compared. Before a migration, or weekly in your own GitHub Actions. Runs npx --allow-git=root github:agentwares/restoreproof locally; no account, no LLM calls of its own, nothing sent to us.
